subject.title: Redesign publish plugin & skill empty states

question: Should the publish pages adopt upload-first progressive disclosure that hides skill/plugin metadata until files are selected, or should this PR preserve the old pre-upload form contract?
rationale: The branch changes the publishing workflow contract and visible UX, so maintainer intent is needed before deciding whether to update automation around the new flow or preserve the old accessible/form behavior.

options.title: Adopt upload-first after repairs
options.body: Keep the progressive disclosure direction, but require local-auth helper/test updates and real branch proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve pre-upload form contract
options.body: Ask for a narrower copy/layout polish that keeps metadata and rights controls available before upload.

recommendation.title: Adopt upload-first after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the progressive disclosure direction, but require local-auth helper/test updates and real branch proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Git history ties Patrick-Erichsen most directly to the current publish routes and local-auth helper contract.
